plate_comment: Selects the high speed governor gain set - error filter coefficient plus proportional, integral and derivative gains - and records its code in high_speed_governor_gain_set_code: the base set (code 16) when system_feature_config_flags bit 0 is clear; otherwise a transient set (code 17, high_speed_governor_transient_*) while engine acceleration is above high_speed_governor_transient_acceleration_threshold and governor_mode_code_prev is not 12, and once high_speed_governor_transient_gain_set_time_limit has elapsed the working set (when loaded) or the low / high reference speed set (codes 18 / 19, chosen against high_speed_governor_low_reference_speed_threshold / high_speed_governor_high_reference_speed_threshold; base set 16 between them); it also records the alternate set. Shared with CM550 0x1d392 (same function: same pass timer, set codes and the 16 constant words at the same relative offsets; CM848 also loads the base set every pass while feature bit 0 is clear) (was selectSensorRawChannels then cm848_selectHighSpeedGovernorGainSet)

evidence: Counts fuel_pressure_sensor_volts samples above fuel_pressure_sensor_pre_start_high_volts_threshold (573 = 0.69 V) in hpcr_checkRailPressureSensorBeforeStart (its only user, xref_addr.py) during the pre-start P0191 check (fault 414, fault_detected_bits_400_to_415 0x4000); a sample in range after a count aborts the check (abort reason 4); saturates at 0xfffe; compared with fuel_pressure_sensor_pre_start_high_sample_limit (20). Time-shared RAM: the boot kernel image of mpc555_tickTransferTimeoutAndRuntimeCounter starts here (the thunk stage keeps this row)
